data.one_liner: Generates color palettes, shades, and Material Design themes in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter library for generating Material Design color swatches, color harmonies (monochromatic, analogous, complementary), and automatic light/dark themes supporting Material 3 color roles.
use_when: You need to dynamically generate Material color swatches and shades from a base color.
You want to build custom monochromatic, analogous, or complementary color palettes.
You need to quickly generate ThemeData pairs (light and dark) using Material 3 color roles.
avoid_when: You already have a pre-defined static color palette and do not need programmatic generation.
You need a full design system UI kit rather than just color and theme generation utilities.
strengths: Supports Material 3 color roles and modern color APIs.
Provides built-in color harmony generation (monochromatic, analogous, complementary).
Simplifies light and dark theme generation with ThemePair.
weaknesses: Limited to color and theme generation utilities.
Does not include pre-built UI widget kits.
